profile.headline: Senior Developer @ TRITON | MAUI.NET, C#, Software Development
profile.summary:
With over 20 years of experience in software development, I have a passion for creating innovative and user-friendly applications for various platforms and devices. I have worked with multiple languages, frameworks, and technologies, such as C, C++, C#, Objective-C, Java, XML, ASP.NET, TSQL, and more.

Currently, I am a senior application/software developer at TRITON Management Services, LLC, where I am developing mobile applications with MAUI.NET which target iOS and Android platforms.  I am also working on our corporate use web apps.  I use C#, ASP.NET, and TSQL to design, implement, test, and deploy the application, collaborating with other developers, stakeholders, and clients. I enjoy solving complex problems, learning new skills, and delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs and expectations of the users.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
09/2012 : Re-orged into QTI (see above).

01/2012 - 09/2012: QSWAT NDS Team.  Development lead on Aggregator application. (C#, ASP.net, TSQL, EF)

08/2011 - 01/2012: QSWAT MPL Team.  Developed a regression test framework to automate testing of MPL system. (C#)

11/2010 - 08/2011: Developed desktop and automation tools for BrewMP developers, OEMs, and testers of all stripes.

06/2006-11/2010: As a member of Qualcomm's Platform Security Group developed subsystems of the BrewMP OS, wrote test code, and various utilities.
 
10/2005-06/2006: Developed the email application bundled with the Siemens/BenQ SXG75 handset.

06/2003-10/2005: Worked in Qualcomm's Enterprise Mobility Group developing internal mobile application solutions.
